title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly derived as E = mv₀²/(2ed).

title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) is correctly derived as B = mv₀/(ed).

title: Total time A to D
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) is correctly derived as t = 3d(4 + π)/(2v₀).

title: Kinematics in electric field
description: Important: Correctly applies projectile motion to find the acceleration and time from A to C using given distances d and 2d.

title: Velocity at boundary
description: Important: Correctly calculates the speed and 45° entry angle of the electron as it enters the magnetic field region.

title: Circular motion in B-field
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law with Lorentz force (evB = mv²/r) and uses geometry to relate the circular path radius to distance d.

title: Time composition
description: Important: Correctly sums the time spent in the electric field (three equal segments) and the 3/4 period spent in the magnetic field.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns sign to the electron's charge in force equations (e.g., using +e instead of -e, or mishandling vector directions).

title: Geometric radius mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly identifies the radius of the circular arc in the magnetic field, failing to derive r = √2 d from the path through the origin.
